# LocalisationEditor

**Class:** `UltraCanvasLocalisationEditor` · **Group:** [Navigation and data views](../Groups/Navigation-and-data-views.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasLocalisationEditor.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasLocalisationEditor.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasLocalisationEditor.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Translations - every set an application's texts come from (its own, the base sets it takes, Standard) in one grid with a column per set; edit, take / promote / demote / merge the sets, Undo, save into the source tree or the settings folder, export, draft ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasLocalisationEditor.md)); `ShowLocalisationEditorDialog` opens it on the running application

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasLocalisationEditor(const std::string& id, float x, float y, float w, float h, LocalisationEditorLayout arrangement = LocalisationEditorLayout::Compact);
explicit UltraCanvasLocalisationEditor(const std::string& id, LocalisationEditorLayout arrangement = LocalisationEditorLayout::Compact);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

## Option types in this header

### struct `LocalisationSetRef`

One set the rows come from, in lookup order: the application, its base sets most specific first, Standard.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `std::string name` | "UltraVideo", "Video", "Standard" |
| `isBase` | `bool isBase = false` | a file under base/ |
| `isStandard` | `bool isStandard = false` |  |
| `isApplication` | `bool isApplication = false` |  |

### enum `LocalisationRowStatus`

Where a row's shown text comes from and what the editor marks it with.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Application` | the application's own word, no set below has it |
| `Override` | the application translates a key a set below also has |
| `Duplicate` | ... with the same text the set below has: an override to drop |
| `Base` | inherited from a base set |
| `Collision` | two base sets translate it differently; the first in order is shown |
| `Standard` | inherited from the standard set |
| `Untranslated` | no set has it in this language: the English is shown |

### struct `LocalisationRow`

One row of the grid: a key, its English, and the text of every set.

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `key` | `std::string key` | "button\|Open", "{n} file" |
| `context` | `std::string context` | "button" of "button\|Open", else empty |
| `source` | `std::string source` | the English text (the key without its context) |
| `plural` | `bool plural = false` |  |
| `categories` | `std::vector<std::string> categories` | the language's CLDR categories, for a plural row |
| `texts` | `std::map<std::string, std::string> texts` | set name -&gt; text (a plural: its "other" form) |
| `forms` | `std::map<std::string, std::map<std::string, std::string>> forms` | set name -&gt; category -&gt; form |
| `shown` | `std::string shown` | what the application shows, in the language |
| `shownFrom` | `std::string shownFrom` | the set that answers; empty when untranslated |
| `status` | `LocalisationRowStatus status = LocalisationRowStatus::Untranslated` |  |
| `collidesWith` | `std::string collidesWith` | Collision: the base set whose text differs |
| `draft` | `bool draft = false` | the answering file is a machine draft |
| `changed` | `bool changed = false` | edited in this session, not saved |
| `inApplication` | `bool inApplication = false` | the application's extraction lists the key |
| `unusedSharedEntry` | `bool unusedSharedEntry = false` | shown only with "the whole set": the application does not use it |
| `compare` | `std::string compare` | the text in the comparison language |

### enum `LocalisationSaveTarget`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `SourceTree` | media/locale/&lt;lang&gt;/&lt;Set&gt;.json in the shipped tree: a clean diff for a pull request |
| `SettingsFolder` | &lt;settings&gt;/locale/&lt;lang&gt;/&lt;Set&gt;.json: only the entries that differ from the shipped file |

### enum `LocalisationEditorLayout`

How the editor places its parts, chosen when it is made.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Compact` | a page or a dialog (about 620 px and up): four rows of controls, the grid, the edit row |
| `Window` | a window of its own: two rows of controls, the grid beside the selected row's panel |
